messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning a weekend surge test (Sat–Sun). Need multivariant creative + geo bid shifts. CPL target $35, overall weekend cap $20k. Who can confirm assets and pacing rules?
Julia: We have 3 creative variants ready: A (hero image), B (customer testimonial), C (demo GIF/video). Propose geo mapping: A -> US East, B -> Midwest, C -> West. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Sam: Sounds good. I'll set up a multivar test with equal weights initially, 48h test window then roll to winners. Planning a 2-stage ramp: canary -> scale. I also want to bump bids in CA by +12% at 18:00 PST dayparts.
Nina: Retargeting list sizes for weekend: 30d = 45k, 14d = 18k. Recommend freq cap 3/day. Confirming GA4 event name is form_submit_v2 on landing. Make sure GTM mapping present.
Adrian: Assets uploaded to Figma and exported in /marketing/assets/wknd_surge_1918. Filenames use suffixes _A/_B/_C and include mobile and desktop exports. Videos: 15s + 30s. Note: variant C animation adds ~200ms load on mobile.
Sam: UTM template I'll use: utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search&utm_campaign=wknd_surge_1918&utm_content={creative}_{geo}. Campaign name: wknd_surge_multivar_1918. Ad group names include geo_abbrev.
Alex: Budget split idea: $8k Sat day, $8k Sat night, $4k Sun. If CPL <= $30 move +20% budget to top geo. Need automatic pacing rules configured.
Nina: I'll create pacing rules in the manager: goal pacing hourly, and rule: if spend > 70% of hourly target and CPL > target then pause lowest-performing geo. Else increase bid by 8% when CTR > benchmark.
Sam: Quick snippet of the bid script I'll attach: ```
if (hourly_spend > target*1.2 && cpl > 35) { pause(geo_low) } else if (ctr > ctr_benchmark) { increase_bid(geo_top, 8) }
```
Julia: What CTR benchmarks are we using? Current baselines: search 1.8%, retargeting 0.9%.
Sam: I'll configure creative rotation: test 48h then winner by CTR -> switch to primary per geo. Also enable dynamic sitelinks only for variant A.
Adrian: Heads-up — keep creative C desktop-only in slow mobile geos due to animation overhead. Also delivered alternate 15s that are lighter.
Alex: Lead routing: all leads from this campaign should go to SFDC queue "Inbound Paid - Weekend Surge" via webhook. Map utm_campaign -> campaign__c and creative into creative__c. Sam, can you confirm mapping?
Sam: Confirmed — webhook + mapping set in the campaign settings. Also added dedupe window 60s and conversion window 7d.
Nina: Retargeting audience ready; I'll apply 14d and 30d lists to separate ad groups. Frequency cap enforcement added.
Julia: Timeline check — canary start Friday 18:00 PST, full ramp Saturday 08:00 PST. Need final asset confirmation by EOD today.
Adrian: Assets approved. final PNGs in the folder, tagged :white_check_mark:.
Sam: Campaign created and canary deployed at 1918000200. Scripts for geo-bid shifts and pacing are live.
CampaignScheduler: Campaign wknd_surge_multivar_1918 started canary at 1918000200 :rocket:
Alex: Perfect — thanks everyone. Please monitor CPL and flag any major deviation (>25% above target).
